business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Automated Dropshipping Networks

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (Republic of the Marshall Islands)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — Codified statute rooted in the United States common-law tradition (corporate law modeled on Delaware and New York), with a Marshallese customary-law overlay and strong influence of U.S. federal law via the Compact of Free Association
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (1986, as amended 2003) — grants duty-free and quota-free U.S. market access for qualifying products and establishes the U.S.-RMI trade and economic relations framework
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) — in force for RMI since 13 December 2020 — regional trade and investment facilitation architecture

No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement is currently in force for the Marshall Islands; the Compact contains only limited tax provisions concerning U.S. federal personnel and grant-related income

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (B.C.A., as amended, including the 2014 and 2018 amendment acts) — Sections 14 through 28 (name clearance, registered office and registered agent) and the beneficial-ownership record-keeping obligations applicable to every business corporation; Anti-Money Laundering Act 2000 (as amended), the Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism Regulations 2008 (as amended), and the Banking Act 1986 (as amended) — all supervised and enforced by the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and the Office of the Registrar of Corporations. The RMI maintains a non-public beneficial-ownership register held by each licensed registered agent and the Registrar, accessible to the FIU and foreign competent authorities on lawful request under RMI's FATF/APG exchange commitments.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — the beneficial-ownership register and all shareholder/director filings are expressly non-public; they are maintained by the licensed registered agent and filed with the Registrar and the FIU in Majuro, and are disclosed to domestic law enforcement and foreign competent authorities only upon lawful request. No public UBO portal or public register exists in the RMI.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the Articles of Incorporation (draft pre-filing copy or as-filed copy) required for payment-processor and opening-bank KYC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Majuro) or the licensed RMI registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization — notarization at country of origin, followed by authentication by the RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Majuro or by the RMI Consular Office (Washington, D.C. or Honolulu). The RMI is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; the apostille route is therefore unavailable and consular legalization is mandatory.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency evidencing current directors and officers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization — RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Majuro) or RMI Consular Office (Washington, D.C. / Honolulu)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (extract from the corporate register)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization — RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Majuro) or RMI Consular Office (Washington, D.C. / Honolulu)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO declaration and beneficial-ownership register extract, together with notarized passport copies for each ultimate beneficial owner (25% or greater direct or indirect interest)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: AML compliance officer of the licensed registered agent, with underlying identity documents notarized by a notary public in each UBO's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Origin-country notarization followed by consular legalization before an RMI consular officer; alternatively, direct notarization before an RMI consular officer where the UBO appears in person at a consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Registered Office and Registered Agent address confirmation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization — RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Majuro) or RMI Consular Office (Washington, D.C. / Honolulu)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all ultimate beneficial owners, directors, officers and authorized signatories against (i) the RMI domestic PEP list and RMI FIU designations under the Anti-Money Laundering Act 2000, (ii) the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List as transposed into RMI regulation, (iii) the OFAC SDN List and OFAC Consolidated Non-SDN List (required by RMI-licensed banks and by the targeted payment rails Stripe and PayPal), and (iv) the RMI domestic list of designated entities and individuals. PEPs are automatically flagged for enhanced due diligence with mandatory senior-management approval of the business relationship and ongoing transaction monitoring. Ownership changes crossing the 25% beneficial-ownership threshold trigger automatic re-screening and re-verification of the incoming owner within the registered agent's AML/KYC file and under the payment processors' merchant KYC contracts.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations of the Republic of the Marshall Islands — RMI Corporate Registry online name-search and e-filing portal, administratively operated under the government concession held by International Registries, Inc. (IRI); all name searches, reservations and filings must be routed through an RMI-licensed registered agent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory rule under Section 14 of the Business Corporations Act: corporate names must be rendered exclusively in English using Latin characters; Marshallese diacritical marks and any non-Latin script are not accepted, and transliteration from other scripts is not permitted. The name must contain a statutory suffix — 'Business Corporation', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated' or the abbreviations 'BC', 'Corp.', 'Inc.' (in established agent practice 'Limited' and 'Ltd.' are also accepted). The name must be distinguishable on the register from all existing corporate names, reserved names, and names of entities dissolved within the preceding three years, and must not misrepresent the legal form or business purpose of the entity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a name (typically issued within five business days of the clearance examination), the applicant may within 14 calendar days lodge a written administrative appeal with the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, attaching the rejection reference, a memorandum on distinctiveness and non-confusion, any written consent obtained from a conflicting-name holder, and the applicable appeal fee. The Registrar must issue a reasoned written determination within 15 business days of the appeal. A further appeal lies to the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands within 30 days of that determination. Where the rejection arises solely from a prohibited or sensitive token, the applicant may instead apply to the competent Minister or the Banking Commissioner for written consent or waiver (for example for 'Bank', 'Trust' or 'Insurance'), after which the name may be re-submitted. Name reservations are renewable for successive 30-day windows upon payment of the renewal fee prior to expiry, provided the name remains available.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely virtual office (such as a post-office box without a physical street presence) is not accepted as the statutory registered office. Section 16 of the Business Corporations Act requires every corporation to continuously maintain a physical registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands at the street address of a licensed registered agent in Majuro. However, the automated dropshipping operations may be conducted entirely remotely from anywhere in the world, and the RMI registered office in practice functions as the administrative or virtual seat of the non-resident, tax-exempt corporation — a recognized and accepted industry pattern for RMI business corporations holding Stripe and PayPal merchant accounts.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate — approximately 10% annualized probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection by the Registrar or the FIU for a non-resident, tax-exempt dropshipping corporation. The enhanced 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced' AML tier raises the probability of documentary inspection (review of UBO files, source-of-funds evidence, invoices, and processor statements) to approximately 15%. Physical inspection, if any, will occur at the registered agent's Majuro address, where the agent rather than the company is the subject of regulatory inspection.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations of the RMI and licensed RMI registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Registrar statutory search fee plus prevailing market agent handling tariff (US$50–US$150 market benchmark)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation fee — 30-day reservation of first-choice corporate name
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations of the RMI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Section 15 of the Business Corporations Act and the Registrar's official fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and e-filing of the Articles of Incorporation for a non-resident Business Corporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of US$250–US$450 for corporate-document drafting and filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation and registration fee (authorized capital up to US$50,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations of the RMI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee per the Registrar's official fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office annual retainer (physical street address in Majuro)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate of US$500–US$1,000 per annum for agent and office services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial-ownership (UBO) register setup and AML/KYC file establishment at the 25% threshold
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI registered agent acting as AML compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: AML compliance package at prevailing market rate; mandatory under the Anti-Money Laundering Act 2000, as amended

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN and domestic RMI sanctions screening of all UBOs, directors and signatories
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI registered agent via FIU-compliant screening vendor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Embedded in the agent's AML compliance program; market rate for the initial screening run

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificates of Incumbency, Good Standing and Registered Office address confirmation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations of the RMI and licensed registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory certificate issuance fees plus agent handling charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization and notarization bundle — five-document set for UBO, bank and payment-processor KYC

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI registered agent or licensed third-party correspondence provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for virtual correspondence and processor KYC facilitation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, as amended, Marshall Islands Revised Code (MIRC) Title 27, §§ 101-116 (formation), § 201 (Articles of Incorporation), § 302 (organizational meeting), and § 402 (officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Business Registry, Majuro, Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required; shares may be issued for any lawful consideration, and no escrow deposit or capital hold requirement applies to a non-resident Business Corporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporator(s) hereby subscribe to all authorized shares of the Corporation as stated in the Articles of Incorporation, with no minimum paid-in capital required by law, and that the registered office of the Corporation shall be located at the address of the Registered Agent in the Marshall Islands as designated in the Articles. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following individuals are appointed as officers of the Corporation: [Name] as President, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Treasurer, each to serve until their successors are duly elected. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the President is authorized to open bank accounts, engage payment processors, and execute all documents necessary for automated dropshipping operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Business Registry (online name reservation portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed corporate name containing a lawful corporate designator such as 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or 'Limited' to the Registrar's name reservation system. The name must be distinguishable from existing entities in the registry. Pay any nominal reservation fee and obtain a reservation certificate valid for 30 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for similarity or prohibited term, submit a secondary name choice or file written consent from the holder of the conflicting name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in accordance with MIRC Title 27, § 201, setting out the corporate name, registered office and agent, authorized shares, statement of purpose, and any optional indemnification provisions. Execute the Articles before a notary public and obtain the registered agent's written acceptance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notarization is deficient or the Articles are substantively incomplete, re-execute before a qualified notary or correct the defective clauses and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Payment of Registration Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Business Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Articles of Incorporation together with the registered agent acceptance and the USD 250 filing fee through the Registry's official e-filing system or by physical submission. Retain the Registry's stamped receipt and filing date confirmation.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for typographical or legal defects, respond in writing to the deficiency notice within 15 days, amend the Articles if necessary, and await final registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Agent and Registered Office Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent in the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent service agreement with an entity licensed by the Registrar to act as resident agent. Confirm the physical street address in Majuro for service of process and maintain the agent's consent on file with the Registry.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed agent declines or is decertified, engage a substitute licensed agent and file an amended registered agent consent with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting and Initial Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold an organizational meeting or execute a unanimous written consent under MIRC Title 27, § 302. Adopt the initial board resolution approving share subscription, accepting the registered office, appointing officers, and approving any bank account and payment processor arrangements. Issue share certificates and adopt By-Laws.
required_dossiers: Minutes of organizational meeting or unanimous written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer appointment is contested or a quorum defect is alleged, call a proper board meeting, ratify the actions, and file corrected minutes with the corporate records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing Dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Business Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the executed Certificate of Incorporation and a certified copy of the filed Articles. Request a Certificate of Good Standing to confirm the corporation's active status for onboarding with payment processors such as Stripe and PayPal and any banking counterparties.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a discrepancy in name, date, or agent details, submit a written correction request with supporting Registry documents and obtain a revised certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for automated dropshipping; any incidental general business permit would fall under the Business License Division, Ministry of Finance and Administration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory industrial or manufacturing operating license required for electronic retail distribution via automated dropshipping networks.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – virtual retail distribution with no physical warehousing, manufacturing, or discharge facility in the Marshall Islands.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No applicable industrial discharge, VOC, or waste handling thresholds apply to cloud-based order relay and drop-ship logistics. If physical operations are later established, RMI EPA registration and Clean Air Act effluent standards will apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety, structural load inspection, or occupational workplace clearance required for fully digital operations. The registered agent's office maintains landlord fire certification; any future office lease must comply with the Marshall Islands Fire Prevention Code and workplace safety requirements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); no dedicated online e-portal for non-resident corporate TIN registration — all applications are channeled through the Registrar of Corporations and licensed registered agents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a non-resident Business Corporation (BC): (1) Incorporate under the Business Corporations Act via the Registrar of Corporations; (2) no local Business License or TIN is statutorily required absent physical or commercial nexus in the Marshall Islands; (3) for banking and payment-processor due diligence, obtain an RMI TIN by filing the prescribed TIN application form, attaching the certificate of incorporation, registered agent details, and notarized board resolution; the Revenue and Taxation Division issues an 8-digit TIN with no recurring tax return filing obligation for foreign-source income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: RMI does not operate a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election regime. Non-resident Business Corporations are automatically tax-exempt for Marshall Islands income tax purposes on all non-RMI-source income. Voluntary election to be taxed under the Income Tax Act is possible only if the corporation derives income from sources within the Republic; such an election is practically never used by offshore e-commerce entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/Sales Tax — RMI has no general indirect tax regime
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable. No indirect tax registration threshold exists. A Business License Tax applies only to entities maintaining a physical commercial establishment in the RMI; fully remote automated dropshipping with no local presence remains outside the scope of any indirect taxation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API connectivity, or digital stamping mandate is imposed by the RMI. Customs export declarations are processed through the RMI Customs Service, but invoices themselves are not fiscally cleared. Payment processor and banking KYC documentation, rather than tax clearance, governs invoice practice.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands does not levy VAT or GST; therefore no 0% export rate claim procedure exists. Goods and offshore services exported from the RMI are outside the scope of indirect taxation. Goods entering or leaving an RMI free-trade zone or customs territory qualify for duty-free treatment upon proper declaration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank proof of international payment)
Certificate of Origin (where requested by destination country)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export zero-rating clawback regime exists because there is no VAT/GST to reclaim. However, fraudulent customs declarations, misdescription of goods, or failure to substantiate export status under the RMI Customs Act may attract penalties up to 200% of the value of goods, seizure and forfeiture of the shipment, and criminal prosecution. For non-resident BCs using RMI bank accounts, anti-money-laundering audits and economic substance documentation requests may apply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI does not maintain a domestic central bank; the U.S. Federal Reserve System is the de facto monetary authority because the U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender pursuant to the Compact of Free Association).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMI has no foreign exchange control framework. Both current-account transactions (trade in goods and services) and capital-account transactions (equity injections, shareholder loans, loan repayments, dividend distributions, and liquidation proceeds) are freely convertible into and out of U.S. dollars without hard-currency rationing, surrender obligations, or exchange-rate band restrictions. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders of an RMI Business Corporation is unrestricted and subject to zero withholding tax; no central bank approval, exchange permit, or prior authorization is required. The only operational compliance overlay is bank-level anti-money laundering (AML) screening applied by domestic and correspondent banks to each credit and debit transaction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement exists under RMI law. Export receipts, including automated dropshipping settlements collected via payment aggregators and commercial bank credits, are invoiced and received in U.S. dollars and may be retained in full by the exporter; therefore, there is no mandatory conversion ratio and no statutory remittance timeline. The absence of a surrender regime is consistent with the RMI's dollarized monetary system.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Transaction Banking Not Offered)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Moderate-to-Low. Globally licensed digital EMI and Banking-as-a-Service providers (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Mercury) generally decline RMI-incorporated business corporations because of jurisdiction-risk overlays, prior FATF monitoring history, and perceived shell-entity exposure. Legally, an offshore EMI without an RMI banking license may not establish a branch or offer locally domiciled accounts in the Republic; however, an RMI entity may maintain an account at an overseas-regulated EMI only if that institution's own onboarding policy accepts the jurisdiction. The targeted settlement rails, Stripe and PayPal, are materially constrained for RMI-domiciled corporate merchants within the current assessment window, which elevates reliance on the domestic banking tier and, where commercially prudent, an intermediate operating entity in a more bankable jurisdiction.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Domestic commercial banks (BOMI and Bank of Guam) mandate an in-person board meeting and physical KYC interview with the ultimate beneficial owner(s) and authorised signatories at the Majuro branch; fully remote account opening for non-resident Business Corporations is not available. A hybrid pathway exists for select applicants through RMI-licensed trustee and corporate-management firms that maintain pre-cleared banking relationships and can complete video KYC, subject to apostilled corporate documents, notarised signature blocks, and a complete enhanced due-diligence file. For the Medium-Risk, enhanced-due-diligence dropshipping profile, physical appearance remains the prevailing compliance baseline.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face e-commerce structure with no physical operating premises and no local management substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing; Registered Agent certificate; registered-office or virtual-office agreement; board resolution confirming substantive decision-making in the RMI; detailed operating-methodology narrative for the automated dropshipping network; platform agreements and processing configuration (Stripe and PayPal); executed supplier agreements; and inter-affiliate service contracts, where applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency, low-value cross-border settlements to multiple supplier jurisdictions (e.g., China, United States) via aggregators and MT103 wires, creating an unstructured payment profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform order-ledger extract matching each retail sale to the corresponding supplier purchase order; supplier proforma invoices; shipping carrier track-and-trace logs; processed-payout statements from Stripe and PayPal; and annual financial projections supporting the stated transaction volumes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Thin capitalisation or mismatch between injected capital and projected throughput, suggestive of layering or unlicensed money-service activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder source-of-wealth declaration; bank reference and six-month statements from the originating funding account; share-certificate register; audited or reviewed financial statements; and a legal memorandum demonstrating that the entity operates as a principal merchandiser taking title to goods, not as a money transmitter, with all settlements tied directly to commercial transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee-shareholder or trust-based beneficial-ownership complexity in a wholly online retail vehicle.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI Business Corporations Act-compliant beneficial-ownership register; trust deed or nominee declaration; passport and proof of address for every natural person holding more than 10% economic interest; independent legal opinion confirming absence of sanctions and PEP exposures; and an undertaking to maintain real-time updates to the beneficial-ownership register.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) inbound wire via SWIFT MT103 in USD from the shareholder or parent bank to the BOMI or Bank of Guam operational account using U.S. correspondent ABA and Fedwire routing; (2) payment purpose coded as 'EQUI' (equity investment) or 'LOAN' (intercompany loan), accompanied by a board resolution and supporting corporate documents; (3) full source-of-funds evidence retained, including shareholder statements, transaction trail, and employment or investment history, for AML reconciliation; and (4) funds credited only after completion of the bank's onboarding EDD file, with any unexplained mismatch in purpose code or counterparty triggering enhanced review and potential return of funds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail: SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfer for supplier payments settled in USD (or CNH and EUR where contractually required) through the domestic bank's U.S. correspondent network, cleared via Fedwire and CHIPS. Secondary rail: card-network settlement via corporate Visa or Mastercard for purchases executed through automated procurement modules, with proceeds from Stripe and PayPal payout sweeps consolidating into the domestic USD account. For high-value periodic procurement orders, a sight or usance Commercial Letter of Credit under UCP600 is available at the domestic bank's discretion, although standard dropshipping economics do not ordinarily require it. The RMI has no local RTGS system; all multi-dealer clearing is therefore correspondent-bank dependent and operates on U.S. dollar finality schedules.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable forward contracts (USD/CNH, USD/EUR, USD/JPY) executed with RMI-authorized domestic banks or offshore correspondent dealers.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/CNY to address onshore renminbi convertibility restrictions for Chinese supplier commitments.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (USD versus supplier-currency floating rate) for matched procurement tenors exceeding twelve months.
Zero-cost collar strategies combining purchased caps and written floors to contain multi-currency supplier cost volatility within a defined corridor.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Fee Filing (BCCA ss.107-108) — certified report naming the registered office, resident agent, directors, officers, issued shares, and paid-up capital; fee assessed on authorized share capital (US$100 minimum; US$200 typical at 50,000 authorized shares; sliding fee scale up to US$500)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Business Registration Office, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fixed calendar window January 1 through April 30 of each year; due no later than April 30; report reflects information as of the preceding December 31; no anniversary-date or fiscal-year trigger and no extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: US$100 late-file penalty after April 30; statutory default notice from the Registrar; forfeiture of corporate franchise; administrative strike-off and dissolution for continued non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Resident Agent and Registered Office Annual Renewal and Confirmation — mandatory continued appointment of an RMI-licensed resident agent and maintenance of a local registered office; agent confirmation is embedded in the Annual Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Resident Agent (contractual renewal; no separate filing with the Registrar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewed annually in parallel with the January 1 – April 30 annual report window; effective from the anniversary of the agent's appointment or per engagement letter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Agent resignation risk; loss or lapse of statutory agent representation; Registrar default action and administrative strike-off where no resident agent remains appointed

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Records Maintenance and Periodic Confirmation — client-side annual UBO and ownership declaration maintained by the resident agent; no public or registrar UBO filing for non-resident Business Corporations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Resident Agent compliance file (discoverable by the RMI Registrar, financial intelligence unit, or lawful process; not filed as a public record)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation customarily obtained with the annual renewal; shareholders must notify the resident agent of any share transfer or beneficial ownership change within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Agent-level AML/CFT regulatory penalty and possible criminal sanctions under RMI anti-money laundering law; refusal by agent to renew; does not by itself trigger corporate strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit obligation and no audit threshold for a non-resident Business Corporation under the BCCA; audit arises only if imposed by the articles or bylaws, shareholder or investor agreement, lender covenant, or applicable regulated-activity licensing (banking, insurance, trust); not applicable to an ISIC 4791 automated dropshipping retail operation
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: None prescribed by RMI law; IFRS or US GAAP commonly adopted for internal financial reporting; no financial statements need be filed with the Registrar and no certified accounts are publicly lodged

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No shareholder or UBO register is filed annually with the RMI Registrar; the resident agent is required to collect, verify, and retain current beneficial ownership information, to update the record within 30 days of any share transfer or ownership change, and to obtain an annual UBO and ownership confirmation as part of the compliance renewal cycle
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (Records of Proceedings of Shareholders, Directors, and Committees)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – USD 1,200 per annum (typical market rate for a licensed RMI resident agent and registered office service; excludes government filing fees)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; estimated USD 6,000 – USD 15,000 per engagement where audit is mandated by an investor, lender, or transactional counterparty

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Non-resident Business Corporation statutory exemption; the residual RMI Income Tax Act headline corporate rate of 11.85% applies exclusively to RMI-source business income of corporations carrying on trade or business within the Republic, from which the present automated-dropshipping BC is structurally excluded).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: De jure full tax exemption for Business Corporations organized under the RMI Business Corporations Act: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no net-worth tax, no estate or gift tax, no withholding tax on dividends, and no gross revenue tax on income derived outside the Republic. The sole recurrent impost is the annual US$250 franchise tax (Business Corporations Act Section 47) plus the licensed registered-agent maintenance fee. The 3% gross revenue tax attaches only to gross revenues sourced within the Republic, which a non-resident automated-dropshipping BC does not generate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Business Corporation Annual Report and Franchise Tax Remittance (Business Corporations Act Annual Return; filed with the Registrar of Corporations through the RMI licensed registered-agent network and the Registrar's online corporate registry portal).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due annually on or before the incorporation anniversary date; the Registrar observes a short administrative grace window before imposing late charges; failure to file and pay for two consecutive years triggers administrative dissolution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Corporate Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: True legal name of the BC and the unique registration number issued at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exactly as set out in the certificate of incorporation; regenerate the name if a prior filing was rejected; a name correction requires a formal amendment, not merely an annual-report correction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Registered Agent and Registered Office in the Republic
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, license number, and physical address of the RMI-licensed registered agent; registered office must be a genuine physical location within the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the appointed RMI licensed agent only; a non-resident BC cannot self-nominate an address; if the agent resigns, a replacement must be filed within 30 days or the Registrar strikes the entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Principal Office and Management Location
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address from which the company's management, decision-making, and commercial operations are actually directed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the foreign management address (e.g., Hong Kong SAR, Dubai, or Singapore); do not insert an RMI address unless genuine RMI physical presence and employees exist.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Authorized Shares, Directors and Officers
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of authorized share capital, issued share classes, and list of incumbent directors and officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident natural or legal persons may hold all directorships and offices; no RMI residency, nationality, or shareholding requirements apply; minimum of one director is permissible, and director details are public-record unless nominee arrangements are lawfully used.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Flat annual franchise tax of US$250 for Business Corporations, irrespective of income, assets, or share capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remit exactly US$250 in cleared funds; confirm the payment reference matches the registration number; the registered agent ordinarily advances the fee and invoices the non-resident owner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by the registered agent and a director that the BC has carried on no taxable activity sourced within the Republic during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The certification must be truthful; mere payment-processing through U.S. rails (Stripe/PayPal) is foreign-source in nature; any RMI fulfillment, warehousing, or solicitation activity would defeat the certification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment attracts a 10% statutory surcharge on the US$250 franchise tax; a certificate of good standing is withheld during default; two consecutive years of non-filing result in administrative dissolution by the Registrar, with reinstatement fees, a struck-off-name restoration charge, and loss of all corporate rights in the interim.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Gross Revenue Tax Return (3% tax on gross revenue derived from sources within the Republic; filed with the RMI Revenue and Taxation Office in paper form or through the Bureau of Revenue's authorized submission channel).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the close of each calendar quarter for any corporation engaging in business within the Republic; non-resident BCs with no RMI-source revenue are outside the filing net and file a nil declaration only if administratively registered for this tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1 - Gross Receipts from RMI Sources
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenues, without deduction for costs, arising from business activities conducted, performed, or sourced within the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter nil (0) where all dropshipping receipts accrue from foreign consumers and foreign suppliers via U.S. payment rails; maintain apportionment memoranda if any RMI nexus arguable exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification and substantiation of gross revenues treated as foreign-source and therefore exempt from the gross revenue tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Annex payment-processor settlement reports showing transaction geography; Stripe and PayPal country descriptors serve as primary evidence of foreign sourcing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory deductions permitted against gross revenue tax, limited to credits and allowances expressly legislated.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No income-type deductions (COGS, advertising, software fees) are allowable against the gross revenue tax; a nil return should claim no deductions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Multiplication of taxable gross revenue by 3%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero where Line 1 is nil; remit in USD with the return; underpayment accrues interest from the original due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 5 - Declaration by Director or Authorized Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signed declaration of truthfulness and completeness of the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be executed by an incumbent director or a lawfully appointed attorney; false nil declarations expose the signatory to criminal penalty.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file: statutory late penalty plus interest on any unpaid tax; understatement caused by false declarations: penalty up to 100% of the understated tax, interest accruing daily at the statutory rate, and criminal referral for fraudulent filing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Republic imposes no withholding tax on dividends declared by a Business Corporation to non-resident shareholders; dividends are statutorily outside the RMI Income Tax Act and the Gross Revenue Tax framework.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI maintains no comprehensive double-taxation agreement network; only a targeted arrangement with the United States concerning shipping and aircraft profits exists, supplemented by Compact of Free Association tax coordination. Administrative protocol: (1) obtain a formal Income Tax Status Certificate or Exemption Certificate from the RMI Income Tax Office/Registrar confirming the BC's non-resident exempt classification; (2) append a certified certificate of incorporation and a registered-agent attestation of no RMI-source activity; (3) present the package to foreign withholding agents when dividend, interest, or royalty income is paid onward, invoking foreign unilateral relief, foreign-tax-credit, or check-the-box/CFC analysis rather than an RMI treaty article; (4) where a foreign jurisdiction withholds erroneously, file under that jurisdiction's protective refund claims; no domestic RMI TRC application exists because the RMI levies no withholding tax available for credit.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT: 0% on outbound royalties and 0% on outbound interest; no treaty-reduced rates are available because no comprehensive treaties are in force. For the automated-dropshipping BC, payments for software subscriptions, platform APIs, and payment-processing fees are foreign-source commercial expenses; ensure the foreign recipient's jurisdiction does not impose royalty/interest character or permanent-establishment attribution on the RMI BC.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - the RMI has no transfer-pricing documentation statute and no statutory Local File or Master File threshold. Prudential benchmark: maintain contemporaneous OECD-aligned transfer-pricing documentation (functional analysis, benchmarking study, intercompany agreements, and margin evidence) where cross-border connected-party transactions exceed US$500,000 in any fiscal year, to defend against foreign CFC, permanent-establishment, and anti-hybrid audit challenges.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI has no domestic Economic Substance Regulations regime comparable to BVI or Cayman; however, the OECD Forum on Harmful Tax Practices and the EU listing process require substance-based gateways for low-tax jurisdictions. A non-resident BC must therefore demonstrate genuine commercial decision-making, operational personnel, and physical management in its actual market jurisdiction to avoid recharacterization as a shell company, foreign tax residence, or place-of-effective-management migration, and to pre-empt CFC and GAAR attacks by revenue authorities of the consumers' and suppliers' jurisdictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion (RMI Income Tax Act and Gross Revenue Tax)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating warehouse, fulfillment, or solicitation activity within the Republic while falsely certifying non-resident exempt status; concealing RMI-source gross receipts routed through Stripe/PayPal; filing a knowingly false nil Gross Revenue Tax return or false non-resident certification in the annual report.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of the full tax evaded plus statutory interest; civil penalty up to 100% of the understated tax; criminal fine up to US$10,000 and imprisonment up to five years upon conviction for fraudulent return; revocation of the certificate of good standing and administrative strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil piercing for fraud: directors who sign false certifications are jointly and severally liable for understated tax and penalties; court-ordered travel bans and asset freezes; imprisonment on criminal conviction; director disqualification under the Business Corporations Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a bare BC with no registered-agent oversight, no board minutes, no accounting records, and no operational nexus while using the entity as a pass-through settlement vehicle among consumers, suppliers, and affiliated entities; failing to maintain the annual franchise-tax filing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution by the Registrar for chronic non-filing; automatic loss of limited-liability protection; foreign tax authorities may recharacterize the entire enterprise as a permanent establishment or integrated trade or business, imposing penalties up to 40% of the underpayment and 100% for willful avoidance, with interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Veil piercing for sham-entity conduct: directors and controlling shareholders personally liable for obligations arising after dissolution; personal exposure to foreign CFC attribution, PFIC consequences, and economic-substance penalties; regulatory disqualification from holding directorships in RMI entities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Violation (RMI Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 and Financial Transactions Reporting Act)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing third-party credit-card and digital-payment funds through automated dropshipping flows without counterparty verification; layering of Stripe/PayPal settlement volumes through the BC to disguise fraud proceeds or sanctions-evasion payments; failing to implement AML controls and transaction monitoring on a merchant account that is US-licensed and AML-regulated.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money-laundering conviction: for individuals, a fine up to US$50,000 and imprisonment up to 15 years; for a body corporate, financial penalty up to US$10,000,000; asset forfeiture and freezing orders; mandatory suspension or termination of merchant acquiring arrangements by Stripe and PayPal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal liability attaches to directors and senior officers who knowingly permit transactions involving criminal property; travel bans and extradition exposure; civil forfeiture of personal assets derived from the enterprise; personal debanking and permanent exclusion from payment-rail platforms.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Cross-Border Fraudulent Commercial Practice (E-Commerce and Wire-Fraud Liability)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Automated dropshipping algorithms that misrepresent product availability, fail to honor chargebacks and refunds, collect undisclosed fees, or ship counterfeit goods; use of the RMI BC to evade foreign consumer-protection jurisdiction and payment-processor liability; conspiracy with fulfillment and affiliate network operators to execute the scheme.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under RMI law: civil restitution, injunctions, and fines for misrepresentation; under the law of the consumers' and payment-rail jurisdiction (United States): wire fraud and conspiracy charges, criminal forfeiture of U.S.-based assets, enforcement of foreign civil judgments; payment-processor liability reverts to the entity and its principals where the corporation is insolvent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Extradition exposure for fraud conspiracy; personal bank accounts and real property subject to freezing, restitution, and forfeiture orders; veil piercing where the BC is a mere instrumentality; imprisonment up to 20 years under U.S. federal fraud statutes.
